sender: Japan Pension Service, Shibuya Pension Office (日本年金機構 渋谷年金事務所)
summary: This letter explains the Student Payment Special Exemption for the National Pension. If you are a student with low income, you can apply to postpone paying the pension premium (17,920 yen per month) for April 2026 to March 2027.

actions.title: Submit the Student Payment Special Exemption application
how: Fill in the enclosed application form and attach a copy of your student ID (both sides) or a certificate of enrollment
Send it by mail to the Shibuya Pension Office with the return envelope, bring it to the National Pension counter at Shibuya City Office, or apply online via Mynaportal

consequences.text: If you neither apply nor pay, the months become unpaid, and you may not receive the disability or survivors' basic pension if something happens to you.

source.text: 申請をせずに保険料を納めない場合は未納となり

consequences.text: If you stay unpaid, you may receive reminders, late fees may be charged, and your property may be seized.

source.text: 未納が続くと督促を行い

glossary.reading: がくせいのうふとくれい
glossary.meaning: special exemption that lets students postpone pension payments

glossary.reading: だいいちごうひほけんしゃ
ざいがくしょうめいしょ

warnings: Months approved for the exemption can be paid later (within 10 years) so that they count fully toward your pension.
